title: Explorer icon
responsibility: Renders a named explorer SVG icon with optional accessible labeling.

inputs.name: HarnessIcon.name
inputs.description: The HarnessIconName catalog key that supplies the drawn path (harnessIcons[name]) and adds the solid class only when the name is in solidIcons, which holds for passed and failed. The component does not check the name against the catalog at runtime, so a name outside the catalog gives whatever harnessIcons[name] returns.

inputs.name: HarnessIcon.size
inputs.description: The side of the square the icon is drawn in, in pixels, applied as both the width and the height of the SVG while the viewBox stays 0 0 24 24. It defaults to 20 when omitted, and the component applies no range check, so any number is passed through unchanged.

inputs.name: HarnessIcon.label
inputs.description: The accessible name of the icon: a nonempty value sets role='img' and aria-label on the SVG, while an empty or omitted value sets aria-hidden='true' and no role. It is meant for an icon that stands alone (beside words the icon has no label and is not read out), the component has no code default so it is undefined when omitted, and the text is not trimmed.

outputs.name: HarnessIcon
outputs.description: An hx-svg element with class hx-icon (plus solid for passed and failed), data-harness-component='harness-harness-icon', viewBox '0 0 24 24', width and height set to size, focusable='false', and one hx-svg-path whose d is harnessIcons[name]. A nonempty label gives it role='img' and aria-label; otherwise it gets aria-hidden='true' and no role.
